description: This file defines the NotStrictlyPositiveException class in the org.apache.commons.math3.exception package, which extends NumberIsTooSmallException. It represents an exception thrown when an argument is not strictly greater than zero.

classes.description: Exception thrown when an argument is not strictly positive, extending NumberIsTooSmallException.
